items.title: Hank Cicalo interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, April 30, 2022
items.q: you’re doing — Billy May’s out there with a big band, you’ve got a hot producer, you’ve got a hot engineer

ctx.x: The worst part of a job in a big studio for a second engineer was to be in the middle of a date, you’re doing — Billy May’s out there with a big band, you’ve got a hot producer, you’ve got a hot engineer, and they turn around and say, “I like the first chorus of track 12 and I put it together with the track of 18” or whatever. They’re all starting to talk and you’re trying to find what take it is. You know? That’s when you get into — it gets crazy. And I always talk like a second engineer because I’ve been it…
Before we wrap up here, I wanted to ask you about two individuals. Duke Ellington. Did you work with Ellington?
